t: Three named illnesses and one open category
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الأَسْقَامِ
p: Aʿūdhu bika mina-l-baraṣi wa-l-junūni wa-l-judhāmi wa min sayyiʾi-l-asqām
m: I seek refuge in You from vitiligo, and from madness, and from leprosy, and from the worst of diseases.
